text:
violet-marketing: Quick note  after the benchmark launch we had a bunch of cross-sends. proposing a cleaner newsletter / launch cadence and behavioral suppression rules. summary + ask below.
samir-growth: Yes please. The inbox noise hit product-led signups hard last run. Key ask: avoid sending benchmark report and webinar invite within 10 days for the same user.
jane-analytics: Data snapshot: Paid-trial newcomers = 8,940; conference-adds = 1,250. Overlap where welcome + benchmark + webinar sent within 9 days = ~12%. SQL I'm using attached to the campaign doc.
cory-campaigns: Proposed cadence for new users: Day 0 welcome, Day 4 product tips, Day 9 benchmark narrative (conditional), Day 20 webinar invite (conditional). For conference leads: push benchmark to Day 12, webinar Day 22.
alex-sales: Important: any contact where sales_contacted=true should be diverted to sales-first outreach and excluded from webinar sends. Also prefer not to send marketing emails within 24h of a sales email.
violet-marketing: Suppression rules: 1) suppress if opened_any_email in last 72h; 2) suppress if triggered_event('first_value_conversion') in last 72h; 3) exclude sales_contacted=true; 4) exclude bounced/unsub. A/B idea: test benchmark at Day 9 vs Day 12 for paid_trial cohort, 10% random holdout per arm. Metrics: 7-day unsub, 14-day benchmark reg, 21-day demo conversions.
jane-analytics: I'll create suppression CSVs and output counts. Expected net send decrease ~15% for paid cohort. Also will add tracking for downstream revenue impact.
cory-campaigns: Implementation notes for Braze->SendGrid: create suppression list name 'launch_recent_engaged_v2' and pass the flag in the template payload. Example code snippet for staging:
```json
{"template_id":"tpl_bench_v4","vars":{"delay_days":9},"suppressions":["launch_recent_engaged_v2","sales_contacted"]}
```
deploy-bot: Campaign plan created: marketing/campaigns/launch-cadence-v2 scheduled 2026-04-05T05:00:00Z (dry-run enabled)
samir-growth: Owners: Jane (cohorts + metrics), Cory (flow changes + staging), Alex (sales flag validation), Violet (A/B spec + calendar). Can we aim for a deploy the week of 04/05?
violet-marketing: Yep. Jane please post cohort counts by EOD Thurs. Cory run a dry-send to the test list and validate suppression subscription behavior. Alex confirm SFDC -> sales_contacted latency.
jane-analytics: Will upload CSV and add a short playbook for how the suppression list is populated. Expected cohort sizes: paid_trial_new=8,940; organic_new=6,120; conference=1,250.
cory-campaigns: Will run dry-send tomorrow and post results in thread. Also will add billing blackout rule for accounts with recent invoices.
violet-marketing: Great work team. We'll review early next week in sync and flip the live toggle if all good. :rocket:
